hypothesis: Slow trends that agree over 28 and 112 completed daily candles persist long enough to survive crypto futures costs; a funding veto removes only positions whose 28-day mean adverse funding exceeds 1 bp per settlement.

data.source: checksum-verified public Binance USD-M monthly archives

signal.decision: Monday 00:00 UTC using only candles with close_time strictly before the decision
signal.direction: Long when both 28d and 112d returns are positive; short when both are negative; otherwise flat.
signal.strength: minimum of absolute 28d and 112d return divided by 28d daily volatility times square-root horizon
signal.funding_veto: Skip when direction times mean realized funding over the prior 28 days is greater than +0.0001 per settlement.
signal.selection: At most the three strongest assets; require at least two; deterministic universe order breaks exact ties.

portfolio.covariance: sample covariance of the selected signed daily returns over 60 completed days, annualized by 365
portfolio.rebalance: weekly; unchanged quantities drift between Monday rebalances

execution.turnover: cost only the signed quantity delta; never close and reopen an unchanged holding
execution.end_of_study: liquidate all positions at the final close with scenario costs

robustness.leave_one_symbol_out: rerun stress after excluding each asset
robustness.uncertainty_diagnostic: 5000 deterministic circular 28-day block bootstraps of full-period stress daily returns; report 10th/50th/90th terminal PnL percentiles but do not use this diagnostic to tune parameters
robustness.continuous_ledger: run once from 2023-01-02 through 2026-09-01; slices never reset cash, holdings or risk state

historical_gate.full_stress: net PnL > 0, Sharpe >= 0.50, max drawdown <= 15%, positive-month share >= 45%
historical_gate.time_dispersion: development and validation stress PnL > 0; retrospective evaluation stress PnL >= 0; largest positive month <= 60% of total positive monthly PnL
historical_gate.neighbors: both predeclared neighboring horizon pairs must have positive full-period stress PnL
historical_gate.symbol_robustness: at least five of six leave-one-symbol-out stress replays must remain profitable
historical_gate.promotion: A pass means paper-forward challenger only for at least 26 weekly decisions and 180 days; live remains disabled.

disclosures: All historical dates have potentially been exposed elsewhere in this research program; none is claimed as pristine OOS.
Daily bars cannot reproduce intraday funding mark prices; the same-day close proxy is explicit and funding attribution will be reported separately.
No parameter grid or post-result threshold adjustment is permitted for S97.
